summary: Add policy bounded generation limits and shared output token budgets (S3)

delivery.outcome: Add explicit per-call output generation limits, operator maxima and an optional shared campaign output-token budget accounting for every actual attempt, including quality rejection and unknown usage.
nonGoals: No input-token or currency spending cap is claimed.
No provider calls with real credentials, dependency migration, PyPI publication or implementation of S5-S7.

architecture.decision: Reuse native complete/_complete_route, transport model parameters, S4 audit and usage writers. A context-local generation scope reserves shared output allowance before effect, settles provider usage before quality acceptance and exposes immutable accounting. Missing usage blocks subsequent budgeted dispatch; CLI/Cursor limits fail explicitly.
interfaceChanges: Add GenerationLimits, GenerationBudget, generation_limits/generation_budget complete() arguments, immutable response.generation accounting and optional component-owned execution/custom-provider token limit configuration; existing defaults unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the additive generation scope, optional policy fields and transport mappings; retain existing audit and journal formats.

commands: Local HTTP wire fixtures for both OpenAI token dialects, Anthropic and Gemini
validation.evidence: Exact integer limits, preserved attribution and no silently ignored unsupported flags.

commands: Policy maxima, invalid values and unsupported transport tests
validation.evidence: Caller can lower but cannot raise configured maxima; reject before provider effect.

commands: Fallback, quality rejection, partial response, unknown usage and concurrent campaign tests
validation.evidence: All actual attempts consume shared reservations; unknown is never zero; truncated responses are not successful.

commands: Protected OneDev and independent exact-head review/merge
validation.evidence: Preserved unlimited behavior and S4 audit integration; exact source independently accepted.
